segments.comment: A Samurai wearing an amulet of magical breathing wishes for a boulder, which drops at her feet, steps west so that she sees it to her east, wishes a pool under herself and searches for a turn; she sinks, and display.c under_water() draws only her own square. #therecmdmenu towards the boulder reaches cmd.c there_cmd_menu_next2u(), which offers "Push the boulder" when levl[x][y].glyph, the remembered glyph, is a boulder (4576). The drawn square is blank here, so the port, which read glyph_at(), left the entry out and moved instead of showing the menu. The seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this recipe.
